data.name: Jawdatun
data.gender_notes: Jawdatun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawdatun is an Arabic name for boys, it is derived from the Arabic word 'jawdah' meaning 'thankful, grateful, blessed'. This name signifies one who is deeply appreciative of Allah's blessings and is always thankful for the bounties bestowed upon him. The name Jawdatun carries the meaning “Grateful, Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jawdatun usually hope their child will grow to embody grateful, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies one who is deeply grateful and thankful to Allah for his blessings.
data.etymology: Jawdatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grateful, Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawdatun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جَوْدَتُون
in_arabic.meaning: جَوْدَتُون تعني جود و سخاء و كرم و احسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: جَوْدَتُون هو اسم مشتق من جود و هو يعني كرم و سخاء و احسان، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الإسلام، حيث يدل على السخاء و الكرم و الإحسان إلى الآخرين. و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تطلق على الإناث في بعض الأحيان.

in_urdu.name: جودتون
in_urdu.meaning: جودتون کا مطلب ہے جود و سخاء و كرم و احسان
in_urdu.long_meaning: جودتون ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جود سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں کریم و سخاء و احسان۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ سخاء، کریم اور دوسروں کے ساتھ حسن سلوک کی بات کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जौदतून
in_hindi.meaning: जौदतून का अर्थ है जोद व सखाई व करम व एहसान
